name: NHS & respiratory
summary: UKHSA 5 Nov: flu low with variable trends, COVID low and falling, RSV rising from baseline; consultants strike 25–26 Nov
state: UKHSA's update of 5 Nov for week 44 says flu is at low levels with variable trends: positivity rose to 7.6% from 6.8% and hospital admissions to 2.83 per 100,000 from 2.51. COVID-19 fell and is low, while RSV rose and is at baseline. UKHSA expects flu and RSV to increase in the coming weeks. Nottingham University Hospitals declared a critical incident on 20 Oct and stood it down by 21 Oct (ITV); no widespread critical incidents were found as of 8 Nov, so Normal is kept.
for_you: People in clinical risk groups are most exposed as winter viruses rise. UKHSA and the NHS publish current guidance. Consultants in England are due to strike on 25 and 26 Nov.
rubric_hit: Normal kept: no widespread critical incidents, and UKHSA reports variable flu trends at low level with RSV at baseline. Watch line (above baseline and rising) is close but not clearly met.

rubric.alert: High or very high flu activity nationally, or widespread critical incidents.
rubric.watch: Respiratory activity above baseline and rising, or several trusts in critical incidents.
rubric.normal: Respiratory activity at baseline and no widespread critical incidents.
